# Ben Foster

> Personal homepage of Ben Foster, a software engineer at the Cabinet Office and
> previously a data scientist at the BBC. A small static site: a landing page
> with projects and links, and a short about page.

## Pages

- [Home](https://www.benfoster.xyz/): Intro, projects, and where to find me elsewhere.
- [About](https://www.benfoster.xyz/about.html): Short bio and contact details.
